meta.rule: Never trust hex values transcribed from rendered images. BP-2's printed palette is CANDIDATE ONLY. Final values are sampled from swatch pixels of an approved render, or derived programmatically, with WCAG contrast computed and recorded per pair.

grounds.paper: blueprint drafting sheets: stroke-first, dark blue field, cyan lines
grounds.panel: the live shell: flat fills, two-tone facet shading, NES-inspired accents

paper.field.note: deep drafting blue; sample from approved sheet

panel.face.light.note: facet lit tone: derive from shell +1 step

panel.face.dark.note: facet shade tone: derive from shell -1 step

typography.display: pixel/bitmap-style face OR pure polygon lettering for marquee; 7-seg counters are ALWAYS segment polygons, never font glyphs
typography.annotation.paper: monospace, 11px floor at final render sizes

process: 1. Agent produces one swatch sheet render (panel roles as filled squares, labeled).
3. Compute WCAG contrast for every text-on-fill pair; record in tokens output.
4. Emit tokens.css (Tailwind 4 @theme) + tokens.static.css, mirroring the tinymachines pipeline.
